Subject: New sign-in to your ohmail account

ohmail.

A new device signed in.

It had not signed in to your ohmail account before.

Device: Unknown device
IP address: unknown
Time: 1 August 2026, 09:05 UTC

If that was you, there is nothing to do.

If it was not, open ohmail yourself and go to Settings › Devices (https://app.ohmail.app/settings/devices). Sign that device out there, and replace your second factor.

We never ask you for a code, a password or a recovery code by mail.
